# fptcloud_database_proxy_types (Data Source)

Lists the proxy types (`lb_type`) a FPT Cloud database cluster accepts, for example `maxscale` for MariaDB and `mysqlrouter` for MySQL.

## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) The Id of the database cluster.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The Id of the database cluster.
- `types` (List of String) The `lb_type` values the cluster accepts.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fptcloud_database_proxy_types" "db" {
  cluster_id = fptcloud_database.db.id
}

output "proxy_types" {
  value = data.fptcloud_database_proxy_types.db.types
}
```
